title: Midwinter Extended OST
description: Extends the music of Minecraft with 13 new songs
body:
## **13 New Songs for Minecraft, composed by elvengf (that's me!)**


This collection of songs I've created are an extension of the mood, emotions, and atmosphere of Minecraft. This pack adds music to the game, it doesn't remove the vanilla music. Just add it as you would any resourcepack and you're good to go!


Here's some links to the album if you want to support me on Bandcamp, or just listen to it on your favourite platform:
